steps.title: Initialize Uptrace
steps.description: Configure OpenTelemetry in your PHP entrypoint:
steps.content:
<?php
require __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Uptrace\Uptrace;
use OpenTelemetry\API\Globals;

Uptrace::configureOpentelemetry([
    // 'dsn' => 'https://<token>@api.uptrace.dev/<project_id>',
    'serviceName' => 'php-service',
    'serviceVersion' => '1.0.0',
    'deploymentEnvironment' => 'production',
]);

$tracer = Globals::tracerProvider()->getTracer('my-app');
$span = $tracer->spanBuilder('main-operation')->startSpan();
$span->setAttribute('custom.key', 'value');
$span->end();

// Flush all buffered spans before script ends
Uptrace::shutdown();

    - name: UPTRACE_DSN

steps.title: Configure Logrus with OpenTelemetry hook
steps.description: Add the OpenTelemetry logrus hook to correlate logs with active trace spans:
steps.content:
package main

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
	"github.com/uptrace/opentelemetry-go-extra/otellogrus"
	"github.com/uptrace/uptrace-go/uptrace"
	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	uptrace.ConfigureOpentelemetry(
		uptrace.WithServiceName("logrus-service"),
	)
	defer uptrace.Shutdown(ctx)

	// Add the OpenTelemetry hook to inject trace context into logs
	logrus.AddHook(otellogrus.NewHook(otellogrus.WithLevels(
		logrus.PanicLevel,
		logrus.FatalLevel,
		logrus.ErrorLevel,
		logrus.WarnLevel,
		logrus.InfoLevel,
	)))

	tracer := otel.Tracer("my-tracer")
	ctx, span := tracer.Start(ctx, "main-operation")
	defer span.End()

	// Logs will now include trace_id and span_id automatically
	logrus.WithContext(ctx).WithField("key", "value").Info("Hello from Logrus + Uptrace!")
}

steps.title: Configure slog with OpenTelemetry bridge
steps.description: Use the otelslog bridge to export slog records as OpenTelemetry log records:
steps.content:
package main

import (
	"context"
	"log/slog"

	"github.com/uptrace/opentelemetry-go-extra/otelslog"
	"github.com/uptrace/uptrace-go/uptrace"
	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	uptrace.ConfigureOpentelemetry(
		uptrace.WithServiceName("slog-service"),
	)
	defer uptrace.Shutdown(ctx)

	// Create slog handler that exports to OpenTelemetry
	handler := otelslog.NewOtelHandler()
	logger := slog.New(handler)
	slog.SetDefault(logger)

	tracer := otel.Tracer("my-tracer")
	ctx, span := tracer.Start(ctx, "main-operation")
	defer span.End()

	// Logs include trace context automatically
	slog.InfoContext(ctx, "Hello from slog + Uptrace!", "key", "value")
}

</configuration>

import uptrace
from openai import OpenAI
from opentelemetry.instrumentation.openai import OpenAIInstrumentor

# Configure OpenTelemetry with Uptrace
uptrace.configure_opentelemetry(
    service_name="openai-service",
    service_version="1.0.0",
)

# Instrument OpenAI — traces all API calls automatically
OpenAIInstrumentor().instrument()

client = OpenAI()

# This call is now traced: tokens, latency, model, prompt are captured
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o",
    messages=[
        {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
        {"role": "user", "content": "What is OpenTelemetry?"},
    ],
)

print(response.choices[0].message.content)

steps.description: Configure Uptrace and instrument LangChain for full pipeline observability:
steps.content:
import uptrace
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate
from langchain_core.output_parsers import StrOutputParser
from opentelemetry.instrumentation.langchain import LangchainInstrumentor

# Configure OpenTelemetry with Uptrace
uptrace.configure_opentelemetry(
    service_name="rag-service",
    service_version="1.0.0",
)

# Instrument LangChain — traces all chain invocations, LLM calls, and retrievals
LangchainInstrumentor().instrument()

# Define a simple RAG-style chain
llm = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4o")
prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
    ("system", "You are a helpful assistant. Answer based on the context: {context}"),
    ("user", "{question}"),
])
chain = prompt | llm | StrOutputParser()

# This invocation is fully traced: prompt, retrieval, LLM call, tokens, latency
result = chain.invoke({
    "context": "OpenTelemetry is an observability framework for cloud-native software.",
    "question": "What is OpenTelemetry?",
})
print(result)
